Like a real deep-space astrophotograph, natural colours, no glow halo around the frame: a small comet with a bright head and a long faint blue-white tail curving diagonally.

Like a real deep-space astrophotograph, natural colours, no glow halo around the frame: a ringed planet with soft violet-and-rose bands and thin tilted rings, half lit from the lower left, night side dark.
Like a real deep-space astrophotograph, natural colours, no glow halo around the frame: a distant spiral galaxy seen at an angle, warm core and blue arms with violet-pink star-forming knots.
